description: Georgia O'Keeffe standing on a rock ledge in Canyon de Chelly dressed in a dark wrap dress and her Hector Aguilar black suede and sliver belt and her black wide brim hat, holding a camera; vistas of extending rock formations in the canyon with sky and clouds above horizon line; a female figure in jeans and a plaid shirt sits crossed legged on the ledge behind O'Keeffe in the viewers right.
title: Georgia in Canyon de Chelly
